title: OEISHeadroom: finding OEIS sequences with computational headroom, and extending seven
description: A filter over all 399,277 OEIS sequences for counting sequences whose published data stops at a value small enough that the wall was patience rather than difficulty, and independent implementations of seven of them. Each implementation is checked by a default-deny gate that first recomputes every term the OEIS already publishes -- 153 values, snapshotted before submission and frozen there -- and only then reports what lies past them. 123 new terms across A319381, A323586, A325555, A325556, A337114, A347414 and A353403.
